E2409

`#Rename({style})` on a type isn't a known casing style.

What

`#Rename({style})` on a type isn't a known casing style.

Why

On a type, `#Rename` sets the wire casing of every field or variant from the closed NamingCase menu `.Camel`/`.Snake`/`.Pascal`/`.Kebab`/`.Screaming`; anything else is rejected so a typo fails at compile time, not on the wire. A string name renames one field or variant.

Fix

Pick one of `.Camel` / `.Snake` / `.Pascal` / `.Kebab` / `.Screaming`, or move a string `#Rename` onto the field or variant it names.

Worked example
